definitions.gloss: (archaic/literary) you; a formal and respectful second-person pronoun used between men of equal or similar rank
definitions.explanation: (archaic/literary) you; a formal and respectful second-person pronoun used between men of equal or similar rank

examples.japanese: {貴公|きこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}きたい→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I would like to hear your opinion.

examples.japanese: {貴公|きこう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧そう⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{貴公|きこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武勇|ぶゆう}→武勇：22162_buyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦おる→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Your valor is known far and wide.

notes:
A formal second-person pronoun from the samurai class, composed of {貴|き} (noble/precious) and {公|こう} (lord/public). Used between men of similar social standing. Unlike the modern hostile connotation of ⟦{貴様|きさま}→貴様：18458_kisama⟧, {貴公|きこう} retains its polite, respectful nuance.

USAGE:
Not used in modern everyday conversation. Encountered in:
- Historical fiction and period dramas (⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧)
- Fantasy novels and games with a feudal setting
- Anime and manga featuring samurai or noble characters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貴殿|きでん}→貴殿：18008_kiden⟧ — you (formal, used in official correspondence; still sometimes used in business letters)
- ⟦{貴様|きさま}→貴様：18458_kisama⟧ — you (originally respectful like {貴公|きこう}, but now hostile/insulting)
- {其方|そなた} — you (archaic, used by a superior to an inferior)
- {御主|おぬし} — you (archaic/literary, samurai register)
